A very difficult day in Baku. Time to regroup as a team for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
#McLarenF1 | #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿

A very difficult day in Baku. Time to regroup as a team for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
#McLarenF1 | #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿

The next race mentioned is the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：博塔斯最后一圈撞墙，哈斯车队奥康第七、比尔曼第九

items.summaryEn:
Lap 43/51: 
Those Red Bulls are quick on the main straight and that’s making it hard for George to break away. 
Kimi gets past Lewis and is in P5. Keep pushing, Team 💪
detailZh: 第43圈（共51圈）：那些红牛赛车在主直道上速度很快，这让拉塞尔很难拉开差距。安东内利超越了刘易斯·汉密尔顿， 目前位于第五位。继续加油，车队💪
detailEn:
Lap 43/51: 
Those Red Bulls are quick on the main straight and that’s making it hard for George to break away. 
Kimi gets past Lewis and is in P5. Keep pushing, Team 💪
keyPointsZh: 比赛共51圈，战报发布于第43圈。
红牛赛车在主直道上速度很快，使拉塞尔难以摆脱身后的对手。
安东内利超越汉密尔顿后升至第五位。
keyPointsEn: The race is 51 laps long and this happened on lap 43
Mercedes cheered the team on to keep pushing
